transcript: Yesterday, my boyfriend Paul and I saw Walking With Bubbles, a new musical written and performed by Jessicahendy, where she tells stories of her life with her son and her ex husband. She recounts how her husband's seasonal depression got worse over time, and no matter what they tried to do, he was really mentally slipping away to the point where it wasn't safe for her and her young son to stay with him. And then she discusses raising her son as a single mother in New York City while navigating how her ex husband was still severely mentally ill and homeless for a period of time, but still interested in maintaining a relationship with their son. It is such a vulnerable and heartbreaking story to tell, I'm sure, but also one of resilience and determination. And despite everything that she's gone through, Jessica is still with what she refers to in the show as the love of her life. Performing this is a master class in autobiographical storytelling and a really incredible story being told with that. Another program for my collection.
